Hosha-na for Rebuilding Sukkot, 5786 — by Shoshana Michael Zucker (Ḳehillat Hod veHadar)
tei:bibl.tei:author: Shoshana Michael Zucker
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: I wrote this Hosha-na for Sukkot 5786 for the weekday minyan at קהילת הוד והדר (Ḳehillat Hod v’Hadar) updating the one I wrote last year. I attempted to balance the memory of the horrors of 7 October 2023 and the tense anticipation of October 2025, after the ceasefire agreement was signed but not fully implemented. Thus, the alternate versions of the line concerning the hostages’ return. It is forward-looking because Sukkot is a time for building, even if that building is fragile. I was initially inspired by the hosha-na text written by Rabbi Annie Lewis in 2023 (that I translated).
